sql: SELECT "trans"."trans_id" AS k, (CASE WHEN "trans"."type" IN ('PRIJEM') THEN "trans"."amount" WHEN "trans"."type" IN ('VYDAJ') THEN -"trans"."amount" END) AS m1 FROM "trans" WHERE (CASE WHEN "trans"."type" IN ('PRIJEM') THEN "trans"."amount" WHEN "trans"."type" IN ('VYDAJ') THEN -"trans"."amount" END) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: net transaction amount: 'PRIJEM' counted positive (in), 'VYDAJ' negative (out) by the documented direction; 'VYBER' undocumented and left out
rank trans rows by net transaction amount

sql: SELECT "order"."order_id" AS k, "order"."amount" AS m1 FROM "order" WHERE "order"."amount" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: rank order rows by standing order debited amount

sql: SELECT "trans"."trans_id" AS k, "trans"."amount" AS m1 FROM "trans" WHERE "trans"."amount" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: transaction amount is stored unsigned (direction in trans.type): summing it gives total volume, credits and withdrawals together, not a net flow
rank trans rows by transaction amount (unsigned)

sql: SELECT "trans"."trans_id" AS k, "trans"."balance" AS m1 FROM "trans" WHERE "trans"."balance" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
why: rank trans rows by account balance after transaction
